rows.note: Use 夢 as the all-purpose noun for imaginary events experienced while sleeping.

example.english: I had a very strange dream last night.
example.traditional: 我尋晚發咗個好奇怪嘅夢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 faat3 zo2 go3 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 mung6

rows.note: Use 發夢 as the all-purpose verb for dreaming in sleep, and also for casual unrealistic daydreaming.

example.english: I had a dream last night that I won the Mark Six.
example.traditional: 我琴晚發夢，夢見自己中咗六合彩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kam4 maan5 faat3 mung6 mung6 gin3 zi6 gei2 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2

rows.note: Use 夢想 for a cherished ambition or lifelong aspiration rather than a sleeping dream.

example.english: My dream is to open my own coffee shop.
example.traditional: 我嘅夢想係開一間屬於自己嘅咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 hoi1 jat1 gaan1 suk6 jyu1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3

rows.note: Use 想 for an everyday hope or wish, such as wanting to become something in the future.

example.english: I dream of becoming a vet one day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 loi4 zou6 jat1 go3 sau3 ji1

rows.note: Use 發白日夢 specifically for consciously daydreaming while awake, rather than ordinary sleep dreams.

example.english: I often dream while I am at work.
example.traditional: 我返工嗰陣成日發白日夢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 faat3 baak6 jat6 mung6
